frontmatter_property_contract.result: Both new property-span tests passed as part of all nine openobsidian-doc tests on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows.
behavior: Returns simple top-level property-shaped keys and raw value spans as byte ranges into the unchanged UTF-8 source.
Supports BOM/CRLF input and Unicode values without normalizing or rewriting source bytes.
Ignores indented child entries and recognizes comments outside quoted and flow values.
Retains blank values and returns no properties when frontmatter is absent or incomplete.
Does not parse YAML or edit/write vault files.
